meta.name: Siam
meta.blurb: Seven fronts from the Shan hills to the Malay sultanates. Restore the tributary realm of the early Chakri kings.
meta.pitch: a 1936 grand-strategy war map of Siam
meta.capitalFalls: The government withdraws up the Chao Phraya to Phitsanulok. The war goes on.
meta.capitalFreed: Bangkok is free again. The tricolour flies over the Grand Palace.

landmarks.desc: Enter Siem Reap, beneath the towers of Angkor
Reach Luang Prabang, the royal city on the upper Mekong

medalNames.ten: Order of the Crown of Siam
medalNames.year: Order of the Royal House of Chakri

days.text: Chakri Day. The dynasty and the city are of one age; hold every front.
Sawatdi Pi Mai. Songkran: water for the elders, a new year on every front.
Chulalongkorn Day. Remember the king who kept the kingdom whole.
Constitution Day. The charter of 1932 is four years old.

meta.motto: Nai nam mi pla, nai na mi khao — “There are fish in the water and rice in the fields.”
